changes: Modified for display: claim IDs and levels read from the label prefixes, the prefix removed from the claim text, boxes re-laid out in one column per level, same-level arrows drawn dashed, centrality recomputed. The claims and arrows are unchanged; the original file is reproduced unchanged under "map".

Class colours added: the file leaves 43 of its 44 claims uncoloured (#ffffff). Each claim's class (cognitive, brain-specific, both, or extrapolation) was transcribed from the preprint's Figure 3, where every box is coloured, and is listed under "added_classes" (table: gnwt-classes.md); the page draws those classes in the shades of the authors' IIT and RPT files. The colours under "map" are the file's own, unchanged.

class_colours.source: colours transcribed from the preprint's Figure 3
